entities.summary: Julie Ann Su is an American attorney and government official who has served as Deputy Mayor of New York City for Economic Justice since March 2026. A member of the Democratic Party, Su acted as U.S. secretary of labor from 2023 to 2025, while she was the deputy secretary of labor from 2021 to 2025. She previously served as the California secretary of labor from 2019 to 2021 and California labor commissioner from 2011 to 2018.
